description: This file contains a portable implementation of an Oracle OCI8 driver for the ADOdb database abstraction layer in PHP. It modifies standard driver behavior for compatibility with specific Oracle features, including handling of bind variables, SQL statement preparation, and query execution. It defines classes for database connection and recordset handling tailored to the 'oci8po' driver.

classes.name: ADODB_oci8po
classes.description: A subclass of ADODB_oci8 providing Oracle OCI8 driver functionality with specific modifications for portability and compatibility.

classes.name: ADORecordset_oci8po
classes.description: A subclass of ADORecordset_oci8 customized for the oci8po driver, managing record fetching and field access with Oracle-specific functions.

methods.name: Param
methods.description: Returns a question mark '?' as the parameter placeholder for SQL queries.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement, converting '?' placeholders into Oracle style ':0', ':1', etc.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Executes an SQL statement possibly with input parameters.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Performs a select with limit and offset, falling back to the base class method if needed.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Handles internal query execution, replacing bind markers '?' with oracle style ':' and bind keys.

methods.name: Fields
methods.description: Retrieves field values from the recordset by column name, in lowercase if specified.

methods.name: _FetchField
methods.description: Fetches metadata for a field using OCI8-specific functions.

methods.name: MoveNext
methods.description: Advances to the next row in the recordset using OCI8 functions.

methods.name: GetArrayLimit
methods.description: Retrieves a limited number of rows with optional offset.

methods.name: _fetch
methods.description: Fetches the current row from OCI8 statement into the recordset.
